t: DEWALT chalk line reel allows precise marking for construction and layout tasks. The robust 30m chalk line is ideal for professional builders, carpenters, and roofers needing accurate straight lines for framing, tiling, or foundation work. Features an enhanced line lock mechanism to ensure optimal tension, holding the line tight during snapping. ToughSeries bold braided line offers high visibility and resilience for demanding environments, whilst a 6:1 planetary gear system prevents line jams, enhancing durability and smooth operation. String replacement is quick via a back access door. A flush handle design allows for convenient storage and prevents accidental unwinding. Chalk sold separately.
